title: Kiron Sankar Roy
summary: Warned against rushing the Assembly Rules and asked that members receive adequate time to study them before general discussion.

title: B. G. Kher
summary: Proposed longer sittings and firm time limits so the Assembly could complete its preliminary business before Christmas.

title: Rajkrushna Bose
summary: Interrupted Somnath Lahiri to ask whether his speech supported or opposed the Objectives Resolution.

title: Vishwambhar Dayal Tripathi
summary: Pressed Somnath Lahiri to clarify whether he supported the Resolution or Jayakar's amendment.

title: H. V. Kamath
summary: Questioned whether Somnath Lahiri was reviving arguments connected with an amendment previously ruled out of order.

title: Hansa Mehta
summary: Supported the Objectives Resolution and argued for equality of status and opportunity, human rights and justice for women without separate electorates or special privileges.

title: P. R. Thakur
summary: Supported the Resolution while seeking political representation and adequate safeguards for the Depressed Classes.

title: Alladi Krishnaswami Ayyar
summary: Rejected Jayakar's competence objections and argued that a constituent body must establish its directing objectives rather than treat the Cabinet Mission statement as an exhaustive statute.

title: Jaipal Singh
summary: Supported the Resolution while foregrounding Adivasi exclusion, representation, equality and indigenous democratic traditions.

title: Damber Singh Gurung
summary: Supported the Resolution while demanding recognition and adequate representation for Indian Gurkhas as a minority community.

title: Dakshayani Velayudhan
summary: Linked the Republic to social emancipation, rejected caste-based separatism and argued for equality and freedom within an independent India.
